name: Cision
description: integrates the Cision API to import press releases/news as content and media.
project_description:
This module provides a service and blocks that integrate with the Cision Next Generation Cision Communications Cloud API.

 Features 
 
 Service with connection to the APIs for:
 
 Total Mentions 
 Searches 
 Stats 
 
 
 A block that displays the total mentions of a give Cision Search and time period 
 
 Post-Installation 
 
 Configure the value for the key cision_username (at /admin/config/system/keys/manage/cision_username) 
 Configure the value for the key cision_password (at /admin/config/system/keys/manage/cision_password) 
 Configure the Cision block in the block layout system or layout builder. 
 
 Additional Requirements 
 This module requires the key module to manage the Cision API username and password: https://www.drupal.org/project/key
